response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_average FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rating_average) AS mean_average FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.rating_average, r.rating_average - o.mean_average AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE r.rating_average > o.mean_average
